==Summary==
The Tidebreaker has indeed been wandering in Serene Bay. After the lighthouse was relit, the beast swam towards a small island covered in storm...

==Steps==
#You have obtained the ship blueprint. Go ask Queequeg about ship repairs
#Deliver the required materials to continue Pequod's repairs
##Collect 100 Palm Logs
##Collect 2,000 Riccioli Fishery Coins
##Retrieve "Pequod Blueprint: Basic"
#Prepare for departure at the dock and head to Serene Bay
#Travel to Serene Bay
#Defeat the Tacet Discords
#Locate the dock in Serene Bay and ask Planck for details
#Complete Planck's mission request
#Complete Priority Requests (0/4)
##Complete Priority Request "Ahab's Request: Finding the Key{{sic|name in event "Find the Key"}}"
##Complete Priority Request "Ahab's Request: A Feather?{{sic|name in event "Feather?"}}"
##Complete Priority Request "Ahab's Request: Into the Underworld{{sic|name in event "Meet the Phantom"}}"
##Complete Priority Request "Ahab's Request: Setting the Trap{{sic|name in event "Rainbow Rush"}}"
#Set sail and catch Titanium Mackerel at the given location
#Light up the lighthouse in Serene Bay

==Gameplay Notes==
*Completing "Search for Starbuck" step awards {{Item|"Sweet Puff"}}.
*Completing "Travel to Serene Bay" step awards ''[[Rover's Journey II]]'' trophy ''[[Tormented Prophet]]''.
*Completing "Set sail and catch Titanium Mackerel at the given location" step awards {{Item|Titanium Mackerel}} and ''[[Wilderness Calls]]'' trophy ''[[Mackerel Gear]]''.
*Completing the quest awards {{Item|Pequod Blueprint: Advanced}}.

==Dialogue ==
{{Quest Description|Here, all fish gather—and since whales are also considered "fish", then...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Pequod)
:''The once wreckage is starting look{{sic}} more like a ship now.
----
;(Deliver materials)
:'''Queequeg:''' Ship almost fixed up. Thank you. Only half to go.
:'''Queequeg:''' Captain's orders. Almost working.
:'''Queequeg:''' As long ship is repaired, will be fine. All will be fine.
:'''Queequeg:''' By the way, that big "fish." Serene Bay.
:'''Queequeg:''' We failed before. You be careful.
----
;(Idle)
:'''Queequeg:''' Ship getting better. Ahab lost his harpoon.
:'''Queequeg:''' Ahab says, once ship is repaired, we can all go home.
:'''Queequeg:''' Ahab is captain. He is right.
----
;(Head to the designated location)
:'''The Tidebreaker knocks over your boat, and you're washed ashore by the heavy waves...
----
:'''Rover:''' Phoebe!
:'''Rover:''' Get out of the way!
----
;(Defeat the TDs)
:'''Phoebe:''' {{Rover}}! Are you hurt?
:{{DIcon}} Still in one piece.
:{{DIcon}} My fish...
:'''Phoebe:''' The Tidebreaker attacked us! Thank Imperator none of us were hurt.
:'''Phoebe:''' Quick, let's check if anything was lost!
:'''You check your belongings...
:''You find a bizarre fish, its color all wrong, and its eyes glow with an unsettling shimmer.
:'''Rover:''' Nothing's lost, except now we've got this...
:'''Phoebe:''' What a strange fish...
:'''Rover:''' How about we take it back to Planck? Maybe it knows what this is.
----
;(Talk with Planck)
:'''Planck:''' ...!
:''The octopus Echo waves its tentacles around as it hands you a not from Ahab.
:'''Ahab:''' "Once it's safe, Planck can swim over to Seren Bay."
:'''Ahab:''' "Since the lighthouse on Starbuck's island is up and running, we can set sail again. We're counting on you and Miss White Hat."
:'''Ahab:''' "There'll be monsters swarming in those waters, ever since Cetus went missing."
:'''Ahab:''' "Word is, the key to Serene Bay's lighthouse got lost long ago. We only know it's somewhere at the bottom of the sea."
:'''Ahab:''' "Oh, I reckon you'll be greeted by a few strange fish along the way."
:'''Ahab:''' "I'll keep poking around and see what else I can dig up. I'll have Planck send word once I've got news."
----
;(Light up the lighthouse in Serene Bay)
:'''Phoebe:''' {{Rover}}! Look, it's the Tidebreaker!
:'''Phoebe:''' They're heading towards that island to the west!
:'''Phoebe:''' Their wounds seem to be healing, but I still feel the intense fury in their cries.
{{Dialogue End}}
